annoyed.look: annoyed, brows drawn in, mouth open mid-complaint

flustered.look: flustered, blushing, teeth gritted in a wavy line

happy.look: happy, faintly blushing, eyes bright, mouth open in a smile

laughing.look: laughing with eyes shut, mouth open in a grin

pouting.look: pouting, brows lowered, lips pushed out

smug.look: smug, eyes closed, a small cat-like smile

surprised.look: surprised, eyes wide, mouth a small o

worried.look: worried, a nervous sweat, mouth open
